admin.guide.dashboard.title: Dashboard
admin.guide.dashboard.content: The dashboard shows a summary of all content across the platform including exercise, book, training, tutorial, and Q&A counts. Click any card to navigate to that section.
admin.guide.exercises.title: Managing Exercises
admin.guide.exercises.content: Upload exercises as PDF files with an optional preview image. Each exercise requires a title (Greek), category, and tags. English translations are optional. You can edit all fields inline and replace the PDF file.
admin.guide.training.title: Managing Training
admin.guide.training.content: Training exercises use content and solution images (uploaded to Cloudinary). Each needs a title, category, tags, and a searchable title for grouping. You can edit and replace images inline.
admin.guide.videos.title: Managing Tutorials
admin.guide.videos.content: Tutorials are external video links (e.g., YouTube). No file uploads needed — just provide a URL, title, description, and creator name.
admin.guide.books.title: Managing Books
admin.guide.books.content: Books support full CRUD with PDF upload, cover images, pricing, and pagination. PDFs and thumbnails are uploaded to Cloudinary via streaming. Books can be toggled active/inactive or soft-deleted.
admin.guide.qa.title: Q&A Moderation
admin.guide.qa.content: View all questions with their answer counts, vote counts, and resolution status. You can delete questions and all associated answers when necessary.
admin.guide.i18n.title: Translations
admin.guide.i18n.content: Content supports Greek (default) and English. Greek fields are required, English fields are optional. Translations are stored as a JSON object on each record with 'el' and 'en' keys.
admin.guide.troubleshooting.title: Troubleshooting
admin.guide.troubleshooting.content: If uploads fail, check that Cloudinary credentials are configured. For CSRF errors, try refreshing the page. Rate limits are per-user: 5 uploads per hour. If you encounter issues, check the browser console and server logs.
